transition.fallback: Replay P1 frozen geometry/brightness-anchor continuity on native-PTS samples. P1 likely edit alone is suspected; P1 likely edit plus corroborated native isolated before-after/within-side ratio and, for v08 SHA match, reuse accepted D4 ranges. Confirmed ones exclude ordinary temporal boost in all operational arms. Counterfactual scores retain the raw unmasked response.
transition.confidence_scope: measured editorial boundary, not scene identity

extremes.density: Nearest per other dimension then inverse sqrt of count of independent root sets within one tau. Greedy closest pair first, reject any repeated or shared root. D6 source-time-only is not independent corroboration in the clean view.
extremes.O: Clip-valid 1-exp(-(nearest difference/tau)^2). No boost from a short segment, ends of segment, unknown continuity, D6-only peers or shared root. The raw exploration counterfactual is also logged.
extremes.C: Per-other-dimension Gaussian nearest support, mean over accepted dimensions, multiplied by the fraction of eligible other dimensions supported for the clean arms.

selection.base: Keep C0 bytes/order. Preserve independently measured short local excursions from P2-21 C4 as the same shared raw-check route, separate from C/O/local ablations. Pure single/relationship/boundary paths keep original selection.
selection.baseline_representative: Legacy threshold on 12x8 context; public observation role and time region from C1; one candidate can join exploration via both routes with its roots merged. No per-dimension seats or fixed N.
selection.local: Use original-size source coordinate support, recorded at analysis resolution for computation. Confirm nomination against temporal median or repeat-support region. Compare same role in the same time region; require registration, bidirectional region overlap and similar normalized crop residual before calling a local candidate substitutable. Audit unknown comparisons and preserve independent localized hypotheses even when entire frame is similar.

observer: Original PNG local receipt only; M9 postponed. Two P2-21 controls keep native bytes/order. Matched dual uniform take only count and public scope, with late final third.
score: Freeze existing strict and broad E0 plus fresh positives before all scored video runs. Do not mark unknown images negative. New inputs are two independent acquisition groups plus one controlled derivative; distinguish gains, losses, first/complete roles, and count-only comparisons.
